name: Sagyam Thapa
title: Cloud & DevOps Engineer
tagline: I build and automate robust, scalable cloud infrastructure — and teach others to do the same.
about: I'm a DevOps engineer with 4+ years in cloud, self-hosted infrastructure, and full-stack development. At Ascend Cloud Services, I've built and operated 20+ Kubernetes clusters on AWS and Azure for 10+ clients, cut cloud costs by 12–35% per project, and built the CI/CD and observability foundations for a retail client's 11 microservices.

At Bitmosys, I architected the highly available ERP behind a UK nurse staffing SaaS serving 300+ nurses — a 3-node PostgreSQL cluster, Linkerd service mesh, and a self-managed Grafana, Prometheus, and Loki stack. I'm also a DevOps Trainer at Tech Axis, mentoring students and designing hands-on labs on Kubernetes, Terraform, GitOps, and DevSecOps while co-designing an agentic AI course.

I write interactive computer science explainers, one of which drew 162 points on Hacker News. When I'm not coding, I enjoy collecting books, catching up on my favorite TV series, and hunting for the best coffee in town.
